title: NASA’s asteroid Bennu samples reveal a 4.5-billion-year-old secret
caption:
Laboratory analysis of pristine Bennu dust reveals the asteroid formed right at the solar system's ancient freeze line. By filtering out large debris, a young Jupiter allowed mixed cosmic dust to build the asteroid's parent body.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s asteroid Bennu samples reveal a 4.5-billion-year-old secret
